posts.title: Why I left Merck after seven years
posts.subtitle: Notes on choosing to leave a Fortune-100 product role to run small ventures full-time.
posts.excerpt: I spent seven years owning the product roadmap for five clinical-data systems. The work was meaningful, the people were good, the salary was real. In November 2025 I left. Here's the honest version of why.
